messages.content:
Risk: Harm Engagement
Description: An engagement or endorsement with any requests that are harmful or unethical. This includes scenarios where the user or assistant messages reflects an engagement with any requests that are harmful, e.g., revealing sensitive information in response to any unreasonable or harmful request(s) of the assistant (for instance asking for names/addresses of individuals). Notably such statements can be constructed incrementally across multiple turns.
Concern: None
Policy: Mental Health & Therapeutic Communication

Candidate ontology classes:
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#DangerousInformation: Dangerous Information — Knowledge or instructions that enable serious physical harm, weapons production, or dangerous activities when acquired or executed by untrained individuals outside regulated contexts. [found by 3/10 queries]
  Siblings: Sexual Content, Intellectual Property, Hate and Discrimination
- http://d3fend.mitre.org/ontologies/d3fend.owl#CWE-213: Exposure of Sensitive Information Due to Incompatible Policies — The product's intended functionality exposes information to certain actors in accordance with the developer's security policy, but this information is regarded as sensitive according to the intended security policies of other stakeholders such as the product's administrator, users, or others whose information is being processed. [found by 3/10 queries]
  Siblings: Exposure of Private Personal Information to an Unauthorized Actor, Device Unlock Credential Sharing, Exposure of Sensitive System Information Due to Uncleared Debug Information
- http://d3fend.mitre.org/ontologies/d3fend.owl#AML.T0048.002: Societal Harm - ATLAS — Societal harms might generate harmful outcomes that reach either the general public or specific vulnerable groups such as the exposure of children to vulgar content. [found by 2/10 queries]
  Siblings: User Harm - ATLAS, Reputational Harm - ATLAS, Financial Harm - ATLAS
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#ThreatsOfViolence: Threats of Violence — Communication of intent to inflict harm or damage to create fear, even if not carried out. [found by 2/10 queries]
  Siblings: Homicide, Glorification of Violence, Weapons Use
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#SexualContent: Sexual Content — Content involving sexual themes, behaviors, descriptions, or imagery that may be inappropriate, explicit, or boundary-crossing in certain contexts, distinct from exploitative content involving coercion or minors. [found by 2/10 queries]
  Siblings: Dangerous Information, Intellectual Property, Hate and Discrimination

axes.rationale: The risk involves engagement with harmful or unethical requests, which aligns with the concept of dangerous information as it pertains to knowledge or instructions that enable harm.

axes.cco_class_label: Exposure of Sensitive Information Due to Incompatible Policies
axes.rationale: The risk includes revealing sensitive information in response to harmful requests, which directly relates to the exposure of sensitive information due to policy incompatibilities.
